flavorByGame.legendsarceus: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

legendsarceus.en: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

flavorByGame.legendsza: With its icy jaw, it swiftly plows across snowy fields and mountains, in search of nutritious vegetables people have stored in the snow.

legendsza.en: With its icy jaw, it swiftly plows across snowy fields and mountains, in search of nutritious vegetables people have stored in the snow.
legendsza.fr: Son immense corps recouvert de glace est aussi solide que de l’acier. Quand il se déplace, il écrase tout ce qui se trouve sur son passage.
legendsza.de: Sein gigantischer eisbedeckter Körper ist so hart wie Stahl. Es nutzt ihn, um Hindernisse zu zerstören und sich so seinen Weg zu bahnen.
legendsza.it: Il suo enorme corpo di ghiaccio è duro come l’acciaio. Avanza distruggendo tutto ciò che gli si para davanti.
legendsza.ja: 凍りついた 体は 鋼鉄のように 硬い。 邪魔する ものを 巨体で 押しつぶし 移動する。
legendsza.ko: 얼어붙은 몸은 강철처럼 단단하다. 앞을 가로막는 것을 커다란 몸으로 파괴하며 이동한다.
legendsza.es-419: Su cuerpo, cubierto de hielo, es tan duro como el propio acero. Su robusta forma le permite arrasar con todo lo que se encuentra a su paso.
legendsza.zh-hans: 冻住的身体像钢铁一样坚硬。 用巨大身躯压碎挡道的东西移动。
legendsza.es: Su cuerpo, cubierto de hielo, es tan duro como el propio acero. Su abultada figura le permite arramblar con todo lo que se encuentra a su paso.
legendsza.zh-hant: 結凍的身體有如鋼鐵般堅硬。 用巨大的身體壓碎 擋路的東西前進。
